unit.why: A disciple tells of secretly watching R. Naftali of Ropshitz perform yihudim through casual stories told to his wife before going to the mikveh. The anecdote is followed by an ethical exhortation against slander.

stories.start_quote: וכך ראיתי למו״ר רבינו הקדוש מו״ה נפתלי מרופשיטץ
stories.end_quote: יתן הש"י בלבו שימחול לי עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: The narrator stood unseen behind R. Naftali of Ropshitz on a Friday before the bath and mikveh, and realized that the rebbe was performing the kavvanot and yihudim of the hot water and the mikveh while telling his wife stories; the rebbe sensed him, turned, fell silent, then finished. The narrator adds that the rebbe never spoke a hurtful word against any Jew and exhorts against slander.
